[RLOW.6.1.8] **A constant lowers to a literal.** The compiler must lower each
read of a `const`, and each `calendar` call over constants ([LTIM.14.3]), to the
literal `Expr` (`proto/rete_expr.proto#Expr`) that holds the value [LEXP.8.8.1]
fixes, in the representation the value's type lowers to: a `Date` to `lit_int`,
its day count, and a `Time` to `lit_time`, its UTC nanoseconds. The engine must
evaluate `lit_time` to the `Time` at that instant with a `tz_offset_ns` of 0
([LTIM.1.1.1]). A constant carries no operation for the engine to evaluate, and
its depth toward [RDSC.11.3]'s limit is that one literal's.
